```yaml
name: Publish Skills to ClawHub

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force publish all skills regardless of changes'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: npm install -g @anthropic/clawhub

      - name: Detect changed skills
        id: changes
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          # Get list of changed files
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          
          # Check if skill.md changed
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "skill.md"; then
            echo "SKILL_MD_CHANGED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
          
          # Find changed skill directories
          CHANGED_SKILLS=$(echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep "^\.skills/" | sed 's|\.skills/\([^/]*\)/.*|.skills/\1|' | sort -u)
          
          if [ -n "$CHANGED_SKILLS" ]; then
            echo "CHANGED_SKILLS_LIST=$(echo $CHANGED_SKILLS | tr '\n' ' ')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "HAS_CHANGES=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "HAS_CHANGES=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: env.HAS_CHANGES == 'true' || github.event.inputs.force == 'true'
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "Force publishing all skills..."
            # List all skill directories
            SKILLS=$(ls -d .skills/*/ 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/$||')
            for skill in $SKILLS; do
              echo "Publishing $skill..."
              clawhub publish "$skill" --accept-license-terms || echo "Failed to publish $skill"
            done
          else
            echo "Publishing changed skills..."
            for skill in $CHANGED_SKILLS_LIST; do
              echo "Publishing $skill..."
              clawhub publish "$skill" --accept-license-terms || echo "Failed to publish $skill"
            done
          fi

      - name: Publish skill.md if changed
        if: env.SKILL_MD_CHANGED == 'true'
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Publishing skill.md..."
          clawhub publish skill.md --accept-license-terms || echo "Failed to publish skill.md"
```
